wikidot5e:spell:entangle.effectSummary: Weeds and vines fill a 20-foot square on the ground starting at a point within range, making it difficult terrain for the duration. Each creature in the area when you cast makes a Strength save or is restrained. A restrained creature can use its action to make a Strength check against your spell save DC, freeing itself on a success. The conjured plants wilt when the spell ends.

wikidot5e:spell:enthrall.effectSummary: Choose visible creatures in range that can hear you. Each makes a Wisdom save; a creature immune to charm succeeds automatically, and a creature you or your companions are fighting has advantage. On a failure, until the spell ends or it can no longer hear you, the target has disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks made to perceive creatures other than you. The spell ends if you are incapacitated or can no longer speak.

wikidot5e:spell:erupting-earth.effectSummary: A 20-foot cube of earth and stone erupts from a visible ground point in range. Creatures in the cube make Dexterity saves, taking 3d12 bludgeoning damage on a failure or half on a success. The ground there becomes difficult terrain until cleared, with each 5-foot square taking at least 1 minute to clear by hand. Each slot level above 3rd adds 1d12 damage.

wikidot5e:spell:etherealness.effectSummary: Enter the Border Ethereal for up to 8 hours or until you dismiss the spell as an action. You can move in any direction, with vertical movement costing 2 feet per foot, and see and hear your origin plane only in gray tones out to 60 feet. You can affect and be affected only by creatures and effects on the Ethereal Plane and can move through objects from the origin plane. When the spell ends, return to your origin plane at your current location; if occupied, you are moved to the nearest space you can occupy and take force damage equal to twice the feet moved. The spell has no effect if cast on the Ethereal Plane or on a plane that does not border it. Each slot level above 7th lets you target up to three willing creatures, including yourself, that are within 10 feet when cast.

wikidot5e:spell:evards-black-tentacles.effectSummary: Black tentacles fill a 20-foot square of visible ground, making it difficult terrain. A creature entering the area for the first time on a turn or starting its turn there makes a Dexterity save; on a failure it takes 3d6 bludgeoning damage and is restrained until the spell ends. A creature starting its turn there while already restrained takes another 3d6 bludgeoning damage. A restrained creature can use an action for a Strength or Dexterity check against your spell save DC, freeing itself on a success.

wikidot5e:spell:eyebite.effectSummary: Choose one visible creature within 60 feet to make a Wisdom save and, on a failure, apply one effect. On later turns you can use your action to target another creature, but cannot target a creature again after it succeeds on a save against this casting. Asleep makes the target unconscious until damaged or another creature uses an action to wake it. Panicked frightens it; on each turn it must Dash away by the safest shortest route if possible, ending the effect once it is at least 60 feet away and cannot see you. Sickened gives disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks; the target repeats the Wisdom save at the end of each turn, ending that effect on a success.

wikidot5e:spell:fabricate.effectSummary: Convert visible raw materials in range into an object made of the same material, with quality limited by the raw materials. The result can be Large or smaller, fitting within one 10-foot cube or eight connected 5-foot cubes; if made of metal, stone, or another mineral it can be no larger than Medium and must fit in one 5-foot cube. The spell cannot create or transmute creatures or magic items. It cannot create objects that normally require high craftsmanship, such as jewelry, weapons, glass, or armor, unless you are proficient with the appropriate artisan's tools.

wikidot5e:spell:faerie-fire.effectSummary: Objects in a 20-foot cube within range are outlined in blue, green, or violet light. Creatures in the area make Dexterity saves and are also outlined on a failure. For the duration, outlined targets shed dim light in a 10-foot radius, cannot benefit from invisibility, and attacks against them have advantage when the attacker can see them.

wikidot5e:spell:false-life.effectSummary: Gain 1d4+4 temporary hit points for 1 hour. Each slot level above 1st grants 5 additional temporary hit points.

wikidot5e:spell:fast-friends.effectSummary: Choose one humanoid in range that can see, hear, and understand you. It makes a Wisdom save or is charmed for the duration and performs services or activities you request as a friendly creature to the best of its ability. You may assign new tasks when a task finishes or you end it. If a task could harm the target or conflicts with its normal activities and desires, it may repeat the Wisdom save, with advantage if you or your companions are fighting it, ending the effect on a success; a task certain to cause its death ends the spell. When the spell ends, the creature knows you charmed it. Each slot level above 3rd lets you target one additional creature.
